arxiv-2306-11702.creator: Zui Chen, Lei Cao, Sam Madden
arxiv-2306-11702.description: Abstract . Data curation is a wide-ranging area which contains many critical but time-consuming data processing tasks. arxiv-2308-12514.title: Privacy engineering through obfuscation
arxiv-2308-12514.creator: Ero Balsa
arxiv-2308-12514.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ero Balsa. Obfuscation in privacy engineering denotes a diverse set of data operations aimed at reducing the privacy loss that users incur in by participating in digital systems. Obfuscation’s domain of application is vast: privacy-preserving database analysis, location-based privacy, private web search or privacy-friendly recommender systems are but a few examples of the contexts in which privacy engineers have resorted to obfuscation. Yet an understanding of the role that obfuscation, in general, plays in the engineering of privacy has so far proved elusive.

We model transaction data as an undirected graph, where nodes represent accounts and edges indicate transactions between them.

pmc-12722063.description: Keywords: biomechanics, nonlinear, slender mechanics, water loss Introduction The responses of plants to water stress are especially noticeable in herbaceous plants that are non-lignified. In non-lignified plants, plant tissues are less stiff, and noticeably deform with a much larger amplitude compared to woody plants.
